rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 3BA grade and notes thinning zona/expanded cavity, but it overstates visibility of specific ICM and TE details in this somewhat blurry single image and infers features not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, cycle history, and embryo grade into prognosis and transfer considerations.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis, though some quantitative adjustments and claims about stress/lifestyle effects are more speculative than firmly supported.

Much of the discussion is broadly IVF-consistent, but several recommendations go beyond standard evidence-based guidance for this case, including routine IM progesterone/estradiol addition, ERA after limited failure, growth hormone, and relatively liberal PGT-A consideration at age 20.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, follow-up, and future planning, but some suggestions are more aggressive than necessary and not all are standard-of-care.
